overloadMerges.note: The doc syntax line has no parenthesized parameter list ('License usage : Collection'), so the mechanical parser produced an empty overload with no return type at all; added the documented Collection return type.
overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns a collection of objects describing the licenses currently retained (per product: usage counts, remaining balance, timestamp, reason, and session details).

constraints: Can only be executed on 4D Server; returns null when called from another context.
